ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What animal takes frog as food?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, containing organisms such as Plantain, Rabbit, Fox, Frog, Snake, and connected with blue arrows. In the figure, Plantain can be seen pointing to Rabbit, Rabbit pointing to Fox; Frog is located above, slightly left of the middle, Snake is located to the lower right of Frog, and there is an arrow from Frog pointing to Snake. Reasoning: According to familiar relationships such as Plantain to Rabbit and Rabbit to Fox, it can be determined that the arrow direction indicates “food/prey points to the animal that eats it.” Therefore, from Frog pointing to Snake means the snake eats the frog.
